metadata.title: Pets-Driven — desktop pets for Claude Code and Codex CLI
metadata.description: A free Windows desktop pet for developers who run AI coding agents. Claude Code and Codex CLI hooks show whether a run is working, waiting on you, done, or failed.
metadata.ogImageAlt: A Pets-Driven pet on a Windows desktop, showing the status of a running Claude Code agent.

hero.headline: You don't code anymore.
hero.tagline: desktop pets for Claude Code & Codex CLI

features.title: What a pet does for you.
features.lede: A Windows desktop pet for people who run AI coding agents. One pet per project directory, so several agents running at once stay readable at a glance.

agents.title: Claude Code and Codex CLI
agents.body: Install the plugin once. Every agent event is forwarded to the pet bound to that project directory.
agents.alt: A pet running alongside the Codex CLI

status.title: Status you can read across the room
status.body: Working, waiting on your input, finished, failed — each state is its own pose and color. When a run ends or stalls, the pet stops and flags you.
status.alt: A pet reacting to a finished task

cli.title: A pdd CLI in the box
cli.body: Hatch, bind, rename, re-skin, and delete pets from the terminal — with the app closed, and with JSON output that pipes straight into a script.
cli.alt: A pet reacting to an agent running in the terminal

petdex.title: Thousands of pets to choose from
petdex.body: Run npx petdex install and the app finds it. Anything in your pet folder shows up during onboarding and pet selection, ready to bind.
petdex.alt: Choosing a pet and sending it out to the desktop

skills.title: Agents hatch their own pets
skills.body: The bundled hatch, bring, and carry skills let Claude Code and Codex do it themselves — every Orca worktree gets a pet without a single click.
skills.alt: A pet hatching for each Orca worktree, with nothing clicked

alive.title: Alive whether or not you're watching
alive.body: With nothing to do, pets greet each other, chat, give chase, and dance. Take one out and toss it around, hand it a treat, pet it and get an answer back.
alive.alt: Pets playing together on their own

demo.title: See it in action.
demo.body: One pet per project. Soon your desktop will be bustling with them.

cta.title: Choose your starter.
cta.body: Pick one folder. That's your first pet.
